Tobias, the depot was **Southgate**. I've posted this as a reply in the thread on your message.

The source is Priyanka's posts in #inc-tansley-carrier-api on 3 Sep 2025. She wrote that label printing had stalled at Tansley Parcel depots and that Southgate dispatch had totes stacked beside door 4. When she closed the incident at 18:43 that day, she said Southgate had cleared the backlog.

I couldn't find a street address or other site details for Southgate in the channels and shared files you have access to. There's no Tansley Parcel account profile in the shared files. If you need the address before the call, Priyanka is the best person to ask.
